comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into a uniformly thin 3–3.2 mm sheet using a spacer-ring rolling pin; candidate separates ceramic finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rolling-pin grasp, level force application and repeated translational compression of deformable dough versus lifting a rigid screen, controlled orientation/agitation, selective aperture flow and loaded support replacement.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires at least 90% thickness compliance, cross-sheet evenness, pastry remaining on the board, damage limits, and the pin set down and released for a 1 s hold. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no spill/damage, screen supported, hands ≥60 mm clear and a fresh 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Pastry rolling tests distributed deformation and thickness uniformity; the candidate tests granular rigid-body separation and retention. Repeated bimanual motion and final tool release are insufficient for overlap, and the multiple spec versions retain this fundamental distinction.
